title: Pakistan Salary Tax Calculator 2026-27
description: Calculate income tax on your salary in Pakistan for 2026-27 with the new FBR slabs. See monthly tax, take-home pay, your slab, and savings vs 2025-26.
quickAnswer: In tax year 2026-27, a salaried person earning Rs 100,000 a month (Rs 1,200,000 a year) pays Rs 6,000 a year in income tax, which is Rs 500 a month. Salary up to Rs 600,000 a year is tax-free; above that, tax is a fixed amount for your slab plus 1% to 35% of the income above the slab's starting point.

formula.title: Salary Tax Formula
formula.expression: Annual tax = Fixed amount of your slab + Slab rate × (Annual taxable income − Slab starting point)
formula.explanation: Find the slab your annual taxable salary falls in, take that slab's fixed amount, and add the slab rate applied only to the part of your income above the slab's starting point. Divide the annual tax by 12 for the monthly deduction. In 2025-26 a 9% surcharge on the tax applied when taxable income exceeded Rs 10,000,000; it does not apply to salaried individuals in 2026-27.

variables.name: Annual taxable income
variables.description: Monthly taxable salary × 12, or your annual taxable salary.

variables.name: Fixed amount
variables.description: The total tax due on all the income below your slab, already worked out for you in the slab table.

variables.name: Slab rate
variables.description: The marginal rate, which applies only to income above the slab's starting point.

commonMistakes.title: Applying the top rate to the whole salary
commonMistakes.description: Falling in the 32% slab does not mean 32% of your salary goes in tax. The rate applies only to income above the slab's starting point; the income below it is covered by the fixed amount. That is why Rs 6,000,000 a year is taxed at an effective 18.4%, not 32%.

commonMistakes.title: Forgetting the fixed amount
commonMistakes.description: Multiplying only the excess by the slab rate leaves out the tax on everything below the slab. For Rs 3,000,000 a year, 20% × 800,000 is Rs 160,000, but the correct tax is Rs 116,000 + Rs 160,000 = Rs 276,000.

commonMistakes.title: Mixing monthly and annual figures
commonMistakes.description: The slabs are annual. Comparing a monthly salary of Rs 250,000 directly with a Rs 600,000 threshold, or dividing an annual fixed amount by 12 in only one place, gives badly wrong answers. Convert the salary to an annual figure first, work out the annual tax, then divide by 12.

commonMistakes.title: Using the wrong tax year
commonMistakes.description: Pakistan's tax year runs from July to June. Salary paid from July 2026 to June 2027 falls under tax year 2026-27; salary paid before July 2026 uses the 2025-26 slabs.

commonMistakes.title: Treating gross pay as taxable income
commonMistakes.description: Taxable income can differ from the salary on your offer letter because of exempt allowances, deductions and tax credits. This calculator applies the slabs to the amount you enter, so enter your taxable salary for the closest estimate.

faqs.q: How much tax will I pay on a salary of Rs 100,000 per month in 2026-27?
faqs.a: Rs 500 a month. Rs 100,000 a month is Rs 1,200,000 a year, which falls in the 1% slab: 1% of the Rs 600,000 above the Rs 600,000 threshold is Rs 6,000 a year, or Rs 500 a month. Your take-home pay is Rs 99,500.

faqs.q: What are the new income tax slabs for salaried persons in 2026-27?
faqs.a: Annual salary up to Rs 600,000 is tax-free. Above that the rates are 1% (up to Rs 1,200,000), 11% (up to Rs 2,200,000), 20% (up to Rs 3,200,000), 25% (up to Rs 4,100,000), 29% (up to Rs 5,600,000), 32% (up to Rs 7,000,000) and 35% above Rs 7,000,000, each on top of the fixed amount shown in the slab table.

faqs.q: Is salary up to Rs 50,000 per month tax-free in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Yes. Rs 50,000 a month is Rs 600,000 a year, which is the top of the 0% slab in both 2025-26 and 2026-27, so no income tax is due on taxable salary up to that amount.

faqs.q: How is monthly income tax on salary calculated in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Multiply your monthly taxable salary by 12, find your slab, and work out the annual tax as the slab's fixed amount plus the slab rate on the income above the slab's starting point. Divide the annual tax by 12 to get the monthly deduction.

faqs.q: What changed in salary tax from 2025-26 to 2026-27?
faqs.a: Rates were cut in four slabs (23% to 20%, 30% to 25%, and 35% to 29% and 32% in two new slabs between Rs 4,100,000 and Rs 7,000,000), the top 35% rate now starts at Rs 7,000,000 instead of Rs 4,100,000, and the 9% surcharge on salaried income above Rs 10,000,000 was removed.

faqs.q: Is there a surcharge on salary income in 2026-27?
faqs.a: No. The 9% surcharge on the tax of salaried individuals earning more than Rs 10,000,000 a year applied in 2025-26 and does not apply in 2026-27.

faqs.q: What is the difference between my tax slab and my effective tax rate?
faqs.a: Your slab rate is the rate on your last rupees of income. Your effective rate is your total tax divided by your total income, which is always lower because the income in the lower slabs is taxed at lower rates. Rs 3,000,000 a year is in the 20% slab but has an effective rate of 9.2%.

faqs.q: Does this calculator include allowances, exemptions or tax credits?
faqs.a: No. It applies the salaried slabs to the taxable salary you enter. It does not account for exempt allowances, deductions, tax credits or rebates, so treat the result as an estimate and confirm your liability with FBR or a tax adviser.

this-is-an-estimate.heading: This is an estimate
this-is-an-estimate.p1: It is for salaried individuals only and ignores allowances, exemptions, tax credits and rebates. Confirm your tax with FBR or a tax adviser.

how-salary-tax-is-calculated-in.p1: Income tax on a salary in Pakistan is worked out on a yearly figure, even though most employers deduct it every month. Three ideas are enough to follow the whole calculation.
how-salary-tax-is-calculated-in.li1: Taxable income: the part of your annual salary that is subject to tax. For most salaried people this is close to their annual pay, but exempt allowances, deductions and tax credits can make it lower. This calculator applies the slabs to whatever amount you enter.
how-salary-tax-is-calculated-in.li2: Slabs: the law divides annual income into bands. The first Rs 600,000 a year is taxed at 0%, and each band above it has its own rate, rising to 35% on income above Rs 7,000,000 in 2026-27.
how-salary-tax-is-calculated-in.li3: Fixed amount plus marginal rate: each slab lists a fixed amount and a rate. The fixed amount is simply the tax on all the income in the slabs below yours, already added up. The rate, called the marginal rate, applies only to the income above your slab's starting point.
how-salary-tax-is-calculated-in.p2: So moving into a higher slab never makes your take-home pay fall: only the rupees above the new threshold are taxed at the higher rate. Your effective tax rate, which is total tax divided by total income, is always lower than your slab rate. Your employer deducts roughly one-twelfth of the annual tax from each month's pay, which is the monthly tax figure the calculator shows.

what-changed-in-budget-2026-27.p1: The Finance Act 2026 changed the salaried slabs for the tax year that runs from July 2026 to June 2027. Income up to Rs 2,200,000 a year is taxed exactly as before, so the changes matter most to middle and higher earners.
what-changed-in-budget-2026-27.li1: Rates cut in four slabs: income from Rs 2,200,001 to Rs 3,200,000 is now taxed at 20% instead of 23%; Rs 3,200,001 to Rs 4,100,000 at 25% instead of 30%; Rs 4,100,001 to Rs 5,600,000 at 29% instead of 35%; and Rs 5,600,001 to Rs 7,000,000 at 32% instead of 35%.
what-changed-in-budget-2026-27.li2: Two new slabs: the old single top band above Rs 4,100,000 is now split into three, so the top 35% rate starts at Rs 7,000,000 a year instead of Rs 4,100,000. That takes the table from six slabs to eight.
what-changed-in-budget-2026-27.li3: Surcharge removed: in 2025-26, salaried individuals with taxable income above Rs 10,000,000 paid an extra 9% of their tax as a surcharge. There is no surcharge for salaried individuals in 2026-27.
what-changed-in-budget-2026-27.p2: Because each slab's fixed amount carries forward the lower rates, everyone above Rs 2,200,000 a year pays less tax in 2026-27 than in 2025-26 on the same salary. Choose 2025-26 in the calculator, or read the comparison line under the result, to see the difference for your salary in rupees per month.

what-this-calculator-does-not-include.p1: This is an estimate for salaried individuals only. It applies the salaried slabs to the taxable salary you enter and does not account for allowances, exemptions, deductions, tax credits or rebates, or for income from business, property or investments, which is taxed under different rules. Rates for non-salaried individuals are also different. If your situation includes any of these, confirm your tax with FBR or a qualified tax adviser before relying on the figure.

working-outside-pakistan.p1: If you are paid in another country, its own tax rules apply to that salary. Our salary tax calculators by country cover the UK, the US and India, and note which Gulf countries do not tax salaries at all.
